mode: Codex image service on the .11 host, edited as a 1:1 patch
why: The garter mark added in 0.4.4 read as a strap pulled tight into the flesh. The strap should just rest on the thigh.

assets.fixes: Removes the pinch and the two flesh bulges around the viewer-right garter band; the band, buckle, connector, stocking, cuffs, warmers and sneakers are byte-identical

method: The .11 service only emits 1024x1536, so a whole-atlas edit came back at the wrong aspect and moved 24 percent of the pixels. Instead the right thigh block was cropped at native pixels into a green 1024x1536 canvas, edited there, and pasted back at 1:1 with a 14-row feather. No resampling of the atlas.
